verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a GPU accelerator hardware product with a supporting compute software stack (ROCm, SMI, Kubernetes operators). It is not a hosted API service that issues API credentials, so scoped or least-privilege agent credentials are a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any credential-issuing capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
